clue.text: Illegal to grow such indoor greenery?

definitions.text: Illegal to grow such indoor greenery?

parts.words: Illegal to grow such indoor greenery?
parts.note: pot is slang for cannabis, so houseplants are jokingly read as cannabis crops that the law forbids

explanation.surface: A question about whether keeping houseplants could somehow break the law.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue plays on two meanings: ordinary houseplants grown in containers, and cannabis, which is slang called pot.
explanation.definitionFit: Houseplants kept in containers indoors are exactly greenery grown inside the home.

clue.text: A number taking exam, what a hubbub inside!

indicators.note: the word for hubbub goes inside the word for exam

parts.note: an oral is a spoken examination
din means a loud noise or hubbub

explanation.surface: Someone sitting an exam exclaims at the noise around them.
explanation.definitionFit: A word like first or second is a number showing position.

clue.text: It's very little money to some Europeans

definitions.text: It's very little money to some Europeans

parts.words: It's very little money to some Europeans
parts.note: describes a tiny coin, a hundredth of the old German mark

explanation.definitionFit: A coin of tiny value, a hundredth of the former German mark.

clue.text: Element any Athenian may be taken in by

indicators.note: the Athenian is held inside the word any

parts.note: Timon of Athens, the misanthrope of Shakespeare's play

explanation.surface: Any Athenian might be fooled by an element.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken in' suggests being deceived, but signals insertion.
explanation.definitionFit: A brittle metalloid chemical element, symbol Sb.

clue.text: But surely he's too young to need one?

definitions.text: But surely he's too young to need one?

parts.words: But surely he's too young to need one?
parts.note: plays on a young ..., an old slang term for a lad, who is too young for a razor

explanation.definitionFit: An electric razor, and also old slang for a young boy.

clue.text: Flirtation is all I want during the ball

indicators.note: the words all I come during, so inside, the word for ball

parts.note: a ball is a formal dance

explanation.surface: A flirt says all they want at the ball is a flirtation.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: dalliance is light romantic flirting.

clue.text: A huge sink?

parts.note: reads like a big basin but points to the vast ocean liner that sank in 1912, whose name also means huge

explanation.definitionFit: An adjective for gigantic, and the name of the liner that sank on its maiden voyage.

clue.text: Tito again the cause of disturbance

indicators.note: the letters of Tito again cause, by rearrangement, the answer

explanation.surface: The Yugoslav leader Tito is again blamed for unrest.
explanation.walkthrough: Tito was the leader of communist Yugoslavia.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: agitation is unrest or disturbance.

clue.text: It makes sense to hold a judicial investigation

definitions.meaning: one of the five senses, the faculty of the ears
a session of a court or tribunal where evidence is heard

explanation.surface: Someone argues that it is sensible to hold a judicial inquiry.
explanation.definitionFit: The ears' faculty is one of the five senses, and a court session listening to evidence carries the same name.

clue.text: Refers to promotional material

definitions.meaning: to advert to something is a formal way of saying mention it

explanation.definitionFit: Formal English uses the verb advert to for mention, and the short form of advertisements names promotional notices.

clue.text: Virginia has Latin translation of "brave"

parts.note: VA is the US postal abbreviation for the state of Virginia

indicators.note: a translation turns words into a new form, so the letters of the word Latin are rearranged

explanation.surface: Virginia offers a rendering of the word brave into Latin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Latin' reads as the language being translated from, but its own letters are the ones the word 'translation' reworks, after the US state abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a courageous, bold person is called brave or valiant.

clue.text: Dead stupid to take one thousand a time

indicators.note: the word for stupid takes the other letters into its middle

parts.note: inane means silly or stupid
I is the Roman numeral for one
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: A slangy remark that it is extremely stupid to accept a thousand pounds on each occasion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dead stupid' reads as British slang for very stupid, but 'Dead' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something dead is lifeless, without the spark of life.

clue.text: In toto, north American city is right-on

indicators.note: the letters go in the word toto

explanation.surface: In all respects, a North American city is up to date.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In toto' reads as the Latin phrase for entirely, but 'In' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The largest city of Canada, in North America.

clue.text: An instrument is the first thing musician requires

parts.note: the organ is a keyboard musical instrument

indicators.note: the first letter is taken from the word thing

explanation.surface: Advice that a musician's first need is an instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the first thing' supplies T, the first letter of 'thing'; 'requires' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A player of the church organ is a kind of musician.

clue.text: Vessel showing a pennant?

parts.note: a pennant is a type of flag
on means on display or showing, as in a play being on

explanation.surface: A question whether a ship is called this because it flies a pennant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vessel' suggests a ship, which fits the pennant, but here it is a large jug for wine.
explanation.definitionFit: A large jug for wine or ale counts as a drinking vessel.

clue.text: Hudson day cruise among the featured

definitions.text: Hudson day cruise among the featured

parts.words: Hudson day cruise among the featured
parts.note: reads as a river outing but lists Rock Hudson, Doris Day and Tom Cruise, actors who headline movies

explanation.definitionFit: Hollywood actors like these three are leading screen celebrities.

clue.text: Unaware of evident need to accept Chinese measure

indicators.note: the word for evident takes the measure into its middle

parts.note: obvious means evident
a li is a Chinese unit of distance

explanation.surface: Someone is unaware of the plain need to accept a Chinese measure.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: oblivious means not noticing.

clue.text: The second letter sounds ironic — or poetic

parts.note: B is the second letter of the alphabet

indicators.note: signals that the word ironic is taken by how it is said rather than spelt

parts.note: the word ironic said aloud gives the sound of the remaining letters

explanation.surface: A remark that the letter B sounds ironic or poetic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sounds' gives YRONIC, said like 'ironic', after B.
explanation.definitionFit: Lord Byron's romantic, brooding style gives the adjective, loosely meaning romantically poetic.

clue.text: Not worth eating in deli — be creative!

indicators.note: being creative with the letters of in deli be rearranges them

explanation.surface: A diner urges a deli to get creative with food not worth eating.
explanation.definitionFit: Unfit to be eaten.

clue.text: The maxim is: before church, go to gym!

parts.note: pre is a prefix meaning before
CE is the Church of England
PT, physical training, is school gym

explanation.surface: A rule of life: go to the gym before church.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a precept is a rule of conduct.

clue.text: Cardinal who was no male chauvinist pig!

definitions.meaning: John Henry ... was a Victorian English cardinal, since canonised

definitions.text: who was no male chauvinist pig
definitions.meaning: a ... is a modern man who shares housework and rejects sexist attitudes

explanation.surface: A churchman described as anything but sexist.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'new man' is a 1980s British term for a man who rejects traditional sexist roles.
explanation.definitionFit: The Victorian churchman bore this surname, and the two-word phrase describes a modern, non-sexist male.

clue.text: Staff for fairy queen's travels

parts.note: a fairy carries a magic wand
ER, Elizabeth Regina, with possessive s

explanation.surface: The fairy queen's staff is for her travels.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: wanders means roams or travels.

clue.text: Having a heavenly body, the German's set apart

parts.note: the sun is a heavenly body
der is a form of the in German

explanation.surface: The German with a heavenly body stands apart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'German's' is 'German has', so the 's is part of the link.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: asunder means into separate pieces.

clue.text: A disciplinarian of tart mien

indicators.note: the answer is made of the letters of the following words, reordered

explanation.surface: A strict figure is described as having a sour expression.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of' signals that the letters of TART MIEN are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A strict enforcer of rules is known by this term, from a French army officer famed for drill.

clue.text: The team needs an hour, twice a day

definitions.meaning: a football or cricket side has this many players
an hour of the clock that comes in morning and evening

explanation.surface: A team needs an hour, twice a day.
explanation.definitionFit: A football side numbers this many, and the clock strikes this hour both morning and night.

clue.text: A Roman city many of us feel at home in today

definitions.text: A Roman city many of us feel at home in today

parts.words: A Roman city many of us feel at home in today
parts.note: points to the ancient Roman settlement that grew into the modern British capital where many readers live

explanation.surface: A Roman town where many people today feel at home.
explanation.definitionFit: The Romans' name for their settlement on the Thames, now the British capital.

clue.text: Touchy-feely contact I let some make

indicators.note: only some of the letters of these words are used, a run concealed inside them

explanation.surface: A tactile person lets some people make contact.
explanation.walkthrough: 'some' takes a run of letters from 'contact I let'; 'make' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to touch, as a hands-on person is.

clue.text: Once puts forward old boy (Ted's taken the name)

parts.note: OB is the abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil

indicators.note: Ted's takes another letter into its middle

parts.note: the name Ted with its possessive s
N is the abbreviation for name

explanation.surface: A former pupil called Ted has taken on a name.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Once' marks the definition as an archaic word.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic verb meaning to offer or allege, so to present an argument.

clue.text: Put out in rare circumstances, otherwise it's bliss!

indicators.note: the rearranged letters go inside the word rare
out means wrong or disordered, so the letters of the word Put are rearranged

explanation.surface: Putting someone out is rare; otherwise all is bliss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put out' reads as annoyed, but 'out' is the signal to rearrange the word 'Put', whose shuffled letters sit within 'rare'; 'circumstances, otherwise it's' only links to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: rapture is ecstatic joy.

clue.text: Not accepting excess without ray's letter is vital

indicators.note: the word for not takes the other letters inside

parts.note: nary means not one, as in nary a word

indicators.note: a letter is removed from the word excess

parts.note: the X of X-ray

explanation.surface: A grammar point about excess losing a letter from ray is vital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ray's letter' is the X of X-ray, which 'without' takes from 'excess'. 'Nary' is an old dialect word for not one.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something essential or vital is required.
